description_en: Queries a list of cloud phone instances
kebab_example: aliyun cloudphone list-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id cp-xxxxxxxxxx --instance-name phone --status Running --biz-key-pair-name testKeyPairName --next-token ADBAAdDWBF20000 --max-results 50 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-i --resolution 192001080 --charge-type PostPaid --instance-type ecp.ce.large --image-id cpm-xxxxxxxxx --show-web-rtc-token false --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --filter Value=2023-11-05T00:00Z Key=ExpiredStartTime --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstances

parameters.help_en: The region where the cloud phone instances reside
parameters.help_zh: 云手机实例所在的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs of the cloud phone instances. Valid values of N: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 云手机实例ID，N的取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the cloud phone instance
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
Pending: being created.
Running: running.
Starting: being started.
Stopping: being stopped.
Stopped: stopped.
Expired: expired
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态。取值范围：
Pending：创建中
Running：运行中
Starting：启动中
Stopping：停止中
Stopped：已停止
Expired: 已过期
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The name of the key pair. The name must be unique. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter. The name cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对名称。必须保持名称唯一性。 长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以 http:// 和 https:// 开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en: The query token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用无需配置
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 返回的最大数，取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The zone where the cloud phone resides
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The resolution used by the cloud phone
parameters.name: resolution

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，支持预付费和后付费，可选值：
PrePaid 预付费
PostPaid 后付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return webRtcToken in the query results
parameters.name: show_web_rtc_token

fields.help_en: The tag key of the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 实例的标签键。N的取值范围为1~20
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 实例的标签值。N的取值范围为1~20
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags used to filter instances
parameters.help_zh: 根据指定的标签筛选实例
parameters.name: tag

fields.help_en:
The filter key for querying instances. Valid values:

ExpiredStartTime: queries resources that expire after the time specified by Filter.N.Value.

ExpiredEndTime: queries resources that expire before the time specified by Filter.N.Value.

CreationStartTime: queries resources created after the time specified by Filter.N.Value.

CreationEndTime: queries resources created before the time specified by Filter.N.Value
fields.help_zh:
查询实例时的筛选键。取值范围：

当该参数取值为ExpiredStartTime时，可以查询指定过期时间点（Filter.N.Value）后创建的资源信息。

当该参数取值为ExpiredEndTime时，可以查询在指定过期时间点（Filter.N.Value）前创建的资源信息。

当该参数取值为CreationStartTime时，可以查询在指定创建时间点（Filter.N.Value）后创建的资源信息。

当该参数取值为CreationEndTime时，可以查询在指定过期时间点（Filter.N.Value）前创建的资源信息
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The filter value for querying instances. When you specify this parameter, you must also specify Filter.N.Key. The value is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format in UTC+0
fields.help_zh: 查询实例时的筛选值。指定该参数时必须同时指定Filter.N.Key参数，格式为:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ，采用UTC+0时区
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The filter conditions for querying resources
parameters.help_zh: 查询资源时的筛选条件列表
parameters.name: filter

AutoRenew.description_en: Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled. This parameter takes effect only for subscription instances
AutoRenew.description_zh: 是否自动续费，只对预付费实例生效

ChargeType.description_en: The billing method of the instance

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the image was created. The time is in ISO 8601 format
CreationTime.description_zh: 镜像创建时间，采用ISO 8601格式

EipAddress.description_en: The elastic IP address (EIP) information of the instance

AllocationId.description_en: The ID of the EIP associated with the cloud phone instance

InternetChargeType.description_en: The billing method of the EIP

ExpiredTime.description_en: The time when the upfront instance expires

KeyPairName.description_en: The name of the key pair bound to the instance

OsName.description_en: The Chinese display name of the operating system
OsName.description_zh: 操作系统的中文显示名称

OsNameEn.description_en: The English display name of the operating system
OsNameEn.description_zh: 操作系统的英文显示名称

RegionId.description_en: The region of the cloud phone

Resolution.description_en: The resolution of the cloud phone instance
Resolution.description_zh: 云手机实例选用的分辨率

SecurityGroupId.description_en: The security group ID. The same security group as ECS is used
SecurityGroupId.description_zh: 安全组ID，与ECS使用相同的安全组

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
Pending: being created.
Running: running.
Starting: being started.
Stopping: being stopped.
Stopped: stopped
Status.description_zh:
实例状态。取值范围：
Pending：创建中
Running：运行中
Starting：启动中
Stopping：停止中
Stopped：已停止

Key.description_en: The tag key of the instance

Value.description_en: The tag value of the instance

VpcAttributes.description_en: The VPC information of the instance

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 100
MaxResults.description_zh: 返回的最大数，取值范围：1~100

NextToken.description_en: The query token for the next page
NextToken.description_zh: 返回下一页的查询凭证
